## Install

1. Download **ClaudeBar.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Move **ClaudeBar.app** to your Applications folder.
3. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so the first time, right-click it → **Open** → **Open**. (On recent macOS, allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security instead.)

Already using ClaudeBar? It offers this update from the panel within a day.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
